description: This file implements an authentication service module for managing user signup, login, and retrieval of the current authenticated user via JWT tokens within a FastAPI application.

methods.name: signup_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str, full_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new user with hashed password, ensuring email uniqueness.

methods.name: str login_user(db: Session, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Validates user credentials and returns a JWT token on success.

methods.name: get_current_user( db: Session = Depends(get_db), credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(bearer_scheme) )
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to retrieve the current user based on Bearer token authentication.

ctags.signature: ( db: Session = Depends(get_db), credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(bearer_scheme) )
